SMTO-CFG-0072 — SMTO couldn't save a settings change

GUID: 209da96e-c774-4411-94ea-bab537ea1375
Slug: settings-schema-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • SMTO tried to save a settings change, such as a conversation's options, to a place it doesn't support, and stopped. Settings you saved earlier weren't deleted.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page and look at the setting you just changed to see whether it shows your new value. The save stopped partway, so check before changing it again.
  2. If your change isn't there, update SMTO from Settings › Setup › Server updates, or run the installer again. This is a fault in SMTO's program files, not in your settings, and a standard installation fixes it.
  3. After updating, make the same change again. Once SMTO saves to the right place, the change is kept.

What success looks like

  • After a reload, the setting shows your new value and no error appears.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't reset, delete or import over your settings to clear this; your saved settings are not the problem.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • AgentUiSettingsStore.update_json_in was called with an internal database schema other than main or composer_settings, so the settings write was refused.

What this means

  • The SQL settings helper is called with an internal schema name other than main or composer_settings. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • The SQL settings helper is called with an internal schema name other than main or composer_settings.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the internal caller's schema argument; this check does not establish corrupt user settings or a migration requirement.

How to fix it

  • Fix the caller of update_json_in (for example api/agent_ui_support/composer_profile.py) to pass schema='main' or 'composer_settings' with the matching attached database; this points to a code or version mismatch. Don't delete or migrate valid settings because of this error.
  • Retain the occurrence and correct the internal settings-writer schema selection; do not delete or migrate valid settings merely for this error.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The writer uses an allowed owned schema and preserves current settings revisions.

What not to do

  • Do not overwrite the original state with an incompatible version; use the supported upgrade path.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
